title: Rhetorical Focus & Information Integrity
goal: Sharpen op-ed arguments using contrastive clefts, prepositional clefts and inverted pseudo-clefts.

items: I can use contrastive clefts (*no es X lo que..., sino Y*) and inverted pseudo-clefts (*X es lo que...*) for rhetorical focus.
I can preserve prepositions and plural agreement in prepositional clefts (*Es en la cámara de eco donde...*).
I can discuss disinformation, synthetic content, content moderation, echo chambers, truthfulness and verification.
